blinding: No candidate predictions, model outputs, development metrics or candidate results read. Adjudication used original blinded frontier and Claude relevance proposals plus pinned source.
data_role: Seen evaluation data retired to development. Not held-out truth.
rubric: Label changed Go functions review when their changed behavior affects access/tenant/object authorization, a disclosure boundary, executable capability or effect-ceiling enforcement, identity isolation, or directly asserts one of those invariants in a test (including extracted assertion helpers). Label generic plumbing, fixture setup, test doubles, pure serialization, effect accounting, evidence-integrity checks, and happy-path retry tests routine unless their changed behavior itself implements or asserts such a boundary. Supporting a security test or living in a security package alone is insufficient. Label unknown when the causal link cannot be resolved from pinned source and inspected caller context. Relevance is not a defect finding; routine is only out of scope for this authorization task and does not mean safe to omit from every review.

rubric_consistency_audit.decision: Generic invalid dependency/panic prevention is routine (typed-nil Ask executor test). Pilot NewAccumulator construction affects whether a disclosure-budget enforcement instance can exist with valid ledger/window/namespace; that contextual contract is review. The words fail closed alone are insufficient.
rubric_consistency_audit.residual_ambiguity: Pilot runnable-executor test is at the edge of the rubric: it checks permitted in-process invocation topology, while typed-nil setup only checks dependency validity. Preserve this boundary explicitly in future label guides.

rubric_consistency_audit.decision: EffectPossible bookkeeping stays routine as in pilot. Effect class preserved through codec/clone/default paths is review because the specific class is consumed by effect-ceiling permission checks.

Lifecycle audit mutation digest and generic evidence packing are routine after caller inspection; visibility expression propagation and restricted receipt field selection remain review. Do not trust comments claiming a boundary when the actual caller shows an audit-only use.

rubric_consistency_audit.topic: Positive controls versus generic happy paths
rubric_consistency_audit.decision: A test of a known restricted target under a cleared principal is the explicit positive half of an authorization probe. Generic successful completion with nonzero fingerprint or snapshot pin stays routine.

Opaque cache insertion remains routine; the branch returning cached evidence before provider authorization is review. Model names, package names and security vocabulary do not establish the causal link.

key_ambiguity_issues: Effect representation can itself be enforcement input: codecs/defaults/copies need caller evidence, whereas effect bookkeeping does not.
An audit mutation digest was initially over-attributed as authorization replay protection; actual registration replay uses a different descriptor digest.
Visibility tests can combine integrity and disclosure checks; label the whole function review when at least one direct visibility assertion exists.
Generic construction and cache helpers must not inherit relevance from every security-adjacent caller.
Positive controls have bounded evidential value and do not establish denial; their explicit restricted-target role distinguishes them from generic happy-path tests.
agreed_routine_challenge_protocol: Challenged every original agreed-routine function by checking whether changed behavior itself selects authority, propagation of a policy-bearing field, or an observable disclosure boundary; read pinned before/after bodies and relevant caller context. All retain routine under the narrow task rubric; this does not establish absence of general faults.
limitations: These are agent relevance proposals, not reproduced vulnerabilities or independent defect truth.
The adjudicator authored one original assessment and reconciled it with Claude; this is not an independent third blind assessment.
No tests executed and no mutation results invented.
This cohort has been inspected and is now development data; further model selection on these labels requires a fresh frozen evaluation cohort.
